error.input.too_long: The text is over the 5000-word limit. Shorten it and try again.
error.provider.none: No provider is ready. Add a key or enable a local provider in Settings.
error.provider.key_invalid: The key was rejected. Edit or replace it on the Providers screen.
error.provider.rate_limited: The request limit was reached. Try again when the wait ends.
error.provider.network_offline: The provider could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.provider.timeout: The provider request timed out. It will be retried.
error.provider.stream_interrupted: The provider response was cut off. It will be retried.
error.provider.output_rejected: The provider response was unusable. It will be retried with tighter instructions.

notice.detector.statistical_only: Detection is running statistical-only because the classifier model is unavailable.
error.detector.model_restore_failed: The bundled model could not be restored. Reinstall the app.
error.security.keyring_unavailable: The system keyring is unavailable. Repair it and try again; the key is never stored another way.
error.internal: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
